templates.description: Bacterial, viral, or spore-borne infectious condition requiring antibiotic treatment and quarantine.
Physical tissue trauma, bone fracture, or puncture wound sustained during scavenging or combat.
Sterile invasive surgical intervention or pharmaceutical stabilization performed by an authorized medic.
Immunological prophylaxis against regional fallout pathogens, providing heightened disease resistance.
High-dosage ionizing radiation absorption recorded through dosimeter ingestion or atmospheric fallout.
Long-term structural, pulmonary, or sensory impairment requiring assistive equipment and ongoing care.
Comprehensive physical assessment of vital signs, radiation burden, and nutritional status.
